besluite.fout: In the glossary definition of 'onderhandel', 'saamstem' (agree) sits in the same lesson as the protected 'vir die eerste keer saam stem' (vote together), and a Grade 4 reader can mix up the two; 'ooreenkom' is also the more usual verb for the outcome of a negotiation.
besluite.rede: The point is real, but this rewords a [begrip] definition beyond a spelling or grammar fix, so the writer has to make the change.
